text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(No! No... No, no, no! It's a lie, there's 
no way she's pulling away...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Because I got stronger...! Far stronger 
than before... and yet...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Why... are you slipping away?!! 
Aaaaaaahhhhhhhhh............!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Now then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Please make yourselves comfortable, 
everyone. To our audience as well—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Of course, and that includes all the 
Umamusume as well.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it? There is no need to stay tense 
from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Who is the winner?" Trading idle, 
frivolous fantasies like that... is quite 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Only one person shall hold victory in 
their grasp. —Please understand that it 
will be none other than myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa...! Haa...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Why... No, losing like this... it's 
impossible!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Both countermeasures and training! Stack 
them up, over and over and over again!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I've grown more than anyone! Even those 
girls believed in me—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Whoaa... Gentile-san, you're amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, going up against someone like 
that... They might just be a little too 
strong...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
What powerful acceleration... She was 
amazing before, but now she's even more 
so...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...It's no good, not like this... I have 
to get stronger, much stronger...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Still, how?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the race, while waiting with her 
younger sisters for Verxina, who was 
taking a long time to return—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Are you okay, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I'm fine. More importantly...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You showed such an unsightly display, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"No, that's not true! Big Sis, you were 
amazing too!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —...Even I feel that way, you know.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
She was the one who was truly amazing... 
Far more than I ever was...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I need to... grow so much, much more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate, I... cannot win the Shuka 
Sho."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Unless I surpass her, I have no right to 
speak of reaching the peak...!
choice_data_list: ...I heard your feelings loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Desiring dramatic growth greater than ever 
before... For Verxina, an opportunity 
second to none was right before her eyes.
choice_data_list:
Let's push ourselves to the limit at 
summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp held to 
sharpen the Umamusume's abilities... 
There, they show tremendous growth. 
However, that meant—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Which means Ms. Gentil will become 
even stronger than she is now..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
B-But... you never know, right? Maybe big 
sis can get a whole lot stronger!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Vivlos. If not... there is 
no future.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I look forward to working with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
In the next Shuka Sho, I must surpass her. 
Please—train me to my absolute limits!
